COTW Companion app data: callers.json (28 callers, DLC flag, level, price, range)
COTW-Wiki fan project data: callers.js (species + DLC per caller, updated Feb 2026)
NamuWiki: The Hunter: Call of the Wild / Tools and Consumables (callers, scents)
Steam Guide: Callers Guide (OUT OF DATE, 2018-2022)
Steam Guide: Every Animal in the Game (2017-2021; notes which animals cannot be called)
Steam Guide: Secret scent and caller effects guide (Finland update, 2021-2022; side-effect percentages, unofficial)
Official: Snowfall Update Patch Notes, June 16 2025 (Alberta callers; elk caller works on Manitoban Elk)
Official: Patch Notes March 24 2025 (Salzwiesen unlocks Raccoon Caller)
Epic Games Store: Ambusher Pack (FOXPRO X360 Electronic Caller)
Steam Store: New Species 2018 DLC (Beacon Deluxe Duck Caller, Short Reed Canada Goose Caller)

callers.name: Axis Deer "Screamer" Caller
callers.dlc: Parque Fernando (COTW-Wiki: Parque Fernando or Emerald Coast)

callers.name: Beacon Deluxe Duck Caller
callers.dlc: Base game (originally New Species 2018 DLC; now non-DLC per cotw-companion)
callers.notes: COTW-Wiki attributes it to the Duck and Cover Hunting Pack; Steam store lists it in New Species 2018.

callers.name: Buck "Snort Wheeze" Caller
callers.notes: Attracts males only (COTW-Wiki, Steam guide). Free with the DLC.

callers.name: Deer "Grunt" Caller
callers.notes: Older guides also list Mule Deer; current sources do not.

callers.name: Elk Caller
callers.notes: Manitoban Elk added June 2025 (official patch notes).

callers.name: Predator "Jackrabbit" Caller
callers.notes: Bobcat listed by COTW-Wiki only (not in cotw-companion species list). Free starting caller per cotw-companion.

callers.name: Wild Boar Caller
callers.notes: Collared Peccary per cotw-companion (COTW-Wiki omits it). Wild Hog not listed by any source.

callers.name: Wild Turkey Crow Caller
callers.notes: Locator call: makes turkeys respond rather than approach (Steam guide).

callers.name: Raccoon "Squall" Caller
callers.notes: Also unlocked by Salzwiesen Park (official March 2025 patch notes).

callers.name: Gadwall Caller
callers.notes: DLC attribution from COTW-Wiki only; unverified.

callers.name: FOXPRO X360 Electronic Caller
callers.notes: Placed remote caller; per NamuWiki it can play any species that has a hand caller and can lure two species at once (FOXFUSION). No source itemizes its sound library, so species is left empty; treat it as covering the hand-caller species. COTW-Wiki names an Ambusher Pack electronic caller "Quist Red Pro"; the store page says FOXPRO X360.

callers.name: Elk Scent
callers.notes: Unknown whether it works on Manitoban Elk.

callers.name: Musk Deer Scent
callers.notes: Musk deer has no caller; this is its only lure (Steam guide).
